palace_custodian.text: Welcome to the Bishop's Palace. It is a ruin now, but it was a rather posh ruin before it was a ruin.
Bishop Henry de Gower built most of what you see between 1328 and 1347. Look for the arcaded parapets, rows of stone arches along the top, just for show.
One bishop is said to have sold the lead off the roof. After that the Welsh weather did the rest.
